To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
NetAdapt is an automated, platform-aware network adaptation framework that improves the accuracy-latency and accuracy-energy tradeoffs of highly-efficient neural networks on mobile devices.

NetAdapt can automatically and progressively find simplified architectures that improve the accuracy-latency Pareto front of MobileNet V2 by up to 2.4X and 1.7X on CPU and GPU, respectively, and by up to 1.8X and 1X on CPU and TPU, respectively.

• NetAdapt is a platform-aware network adaptation method for mobile neural networks that • Automatically and progressively simplifies the neural network architecture • Incorporates the direct metric of interest (e.g., accuracy, latency) in the adaptation process • Improves the trade-off of highly efficient neural network architectures (e.g., MobileNet) • The proposed method is applicable to a broad range of neural network architectures and target platforms.
